description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading firmware on MediaTek MT7623-based devices, including legacy full system upgrade routines, image validation, and configuration copy procedures.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Handles full upgrade of MediaTek MMC devices, including partition comparison, image writing, and partition UUID updates.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board type, including handling full images and partial images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image by checking its magic number against supported formats for the device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device configuration files to the recovery partition as part of upgrade process.
